# artifactapi_remote (Data Source)

Read an existing ArtifactAPI remote.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the configuration of an existing remote by name.
# All fields (base_url, package_type, TTLs, patterns, etc.) are available
# as computed attributes.
data "artifactapi_remote" "dockerhub" {
  name = "dockerhub"
}

output "dockerhub_base_url" {
  value = data.artifactapi_remote.dockerhub.base_url
}

output "dockerhub_package_type" {
  value = data.artifactapi_remote.dockerhub.package_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the remote to read.

### Read-Only

- `ban_tags` (List of String) Banned tags (docker only).
- `ban_tags_enabled` (Boolean) Whether tag banning is enabled (docker only).
- `base_url` (String) Upstream repository base URL.
- `blocklist` (List of String) Paths that are always denied.
- `cache_repodata` (Boolean) Whether generated repodata is cached (github_rpm only).
- `check_mutable` (Boolean) Whether mutable artifacts are conditionally revalidated.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description.
- `github_app` (String) Name of the GitHub App authenticating upstream GitHub requests.
- `immutable_patterns` (List of String) Paths forced to be treated as immutable.
- `immutable_ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds for immutable artifacts (0 = forever).
- `managed_by` (String) What manages the repository (e.g. terraform).
- `mirror_strategy` (String) Mirror load-balancing strategy: round_robin or least_conn.
- `mirrorlist` (List of String) Extra upstream mirror base URLs (rpm/deb/alpine only).
- `mutable_patterns` (List of String) Paths forced to be treated as mutable.
- `mutable_ttl` (Number) TTL in seconds for mutable artifacts.
- `package_type` (String) Package type of the repository (e.g. docker, helm, rpm).
- `patterns` (List of String) Allowlist of paths to proxy (empty = all).
- `quarantine_days` (Number) Days new artifacts are quarantined.
- `quarantine_enabled` (Boolean) Whether newly published upstream artifacts are quarantined.
- `releases_remote` (String) Name of the backend remote that serves download bytes.
- `serve_stale` (Boolean) Whether rpm/deb/alpine virtuals serve this member's last good index while it refreshes.
- `stale_on_error` (Boolean) Whether stale cached content is served when upstream is unreachable.
- `sync_interval` (Number) Release re-scan interval in seconds (github_rpm/github_deb/github_alpine only).
- `upstream_dial_timeout` (Number) Upstream TCP connect timeout in seconds (0 = server default).
- `upstream_response_header_timeout` (Number) Upstream response-header timeout in seconds (0 = server default).
- `upstream_tls_timeout` (Number) Upstream TLS handshake timeout in seconds (0 = server default).
